lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction of the 2560 px pipeline derivation; gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and local ambient occlusion are present; no directional cast-shadow field, sun angle, or time-of-day treatment was observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median bounding-box width across 17 isolated dark-green conifer crown components, scaled by 2560/1254.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad coherent plateau and ledge surfaces versus exposed coastal, gorge, and bench faces; remaining land is broken rock, talus, or sparse cover.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification and connected tracing of the painted sea, full surf and wash margin, tarn, fall, and stream; not polyline geometry.

local_lanczos3_pipeline_reproduction.note: The repository checker could not execute because the managed sandbox denied node.exe script execution; this reproduction uses the same 2560 derivation, mask threshold and feather, and blue-fringe classifier.
